For extrinsic evaluation, we seek to understand the effect of different quality knowledge sentences on the downstream task of response generation. Here, we first finetune the language modeling head of a GPT2 medium-model on the original WOW corpus, using a similar setup as where the groundtruth knowledge and response are used for teacher-forcing training.
We also experimented with computing automatic evaluation metrics such as ROUGE with respect to the human responses in the original WOW dataset but found the results quite low.
